summary: Iteration 13 gap-fix validation: all 4 fixes verified end-to-end. Backend light regression (7/7 pytest pass): /api/billing/customers GET+POST, /suppliers GET, /invoices GET, /parties/{id}, /parties/{id}/statement, /parties/{id}/statement.pdf (200, application/pdf, %PDF-), /gstin/lookup/{gstin}. Frontend Playwright (7/7 flows pass with fresh registered user + seeded customer & supplier): (1) Parties card is clickable — clicking party-{id} card navigates to /billing/parties/{id} and PartyProfile renders (data-testid='party-profile-page' visible); (2) Edit icon (party-edit-{id}) opens the Edit dialog with party-name input visible and does NOT navigate; (3) Delete icon (party-delete-{id}) triggers window.confirm which was dismissed — no navigation; (4) BillingSidebar contains ZERO /customers, /suppliers, /reports-ai links; Parties section has 3 in-workspace children (All Parties, Customer Ledger, Supplier Ledger) with correct data-testids, and clicking Customer Ledger routes to /billing/customer-ledger with sidebar still visible; (5) CustomerLedger row has customer-ledger-statement-{id} button that triggers a PDF download (statement-TEST_UI_Cust.pdf) without navigating; (6) SupplierLedger same behavior (statement-TEST_UI_Supp.pdf); (7) InvoiceCreate /billing/invoices/new?type=purchase preselects invoice_type='purchase' (label 'Purchase Bill'), /?type=sales-order preselects 'sales-order' (label 'Sales Order'); dropdown lists exactly 9 options: tax, gst, purchase, proforma, quotation, sales-order, challan, credit, debit.
critical_code_review_comments: Parties.jsx: openEdit spreads full party object into form (setForm({...emptyForm, ...p})) which includes id/outstanding/created_at/etc — harmless because the PATCH endpoint likely ignores extras, but a whitelist pick would be cleaner and avoid the React 'value prop should not be null' console warning observed on the opening_balance Input when p.opening_balance is null.

BillingSidebar.jsx: 'Customer Ledger' and 'Supplier Ledger' now appear as children under BOTH 'Parties' AND 'Ledgers' sections (duplication). Consider consolidating to one location, or if intentional as a convenience shortcut, note it in UX docs. Currently both work identically.
CustomerLedger/SupplierLedger downloadPartyStatement helpers are duplicated line-for-line (except the toast text). Extract into a shared util in /lib to keep DRY.
Parties.jsx: delete confirm still uses window.confirm — not accessible; consider AlertDialog to match app-wide pattern (repeated from iter12 code review, still not addressed).
